climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: A Lombardy appellation for red wine, including sparkling and semi-sparkling styles, made from five allowed grapes: Barbera, Croatina, Pinot Nero, Uva Rara and Vespolina.
